slides.title: The change-window checklist that kills the *2am rollback*.
1 — Pre-checks, captured
slides.body:
Snapshot configs, routes, neighbors, counters — *before* anything changes.
Not "looks good." Recorded.

slides.title: 2 — Blast radius, written down
slides.body:
What can this break, worst case?
*"Not sure" means not ready.*

slides.title: 3 — A back-out that's been run
slides.body:
An untested rollback is a *theory*.
Rehearse it. Mark the point of no return.

slides.title: 4 — One named decision-maker
slides.body:
Proceed or roll back — *one owner*, criteria written at 2pm.
Never a group-chat vote.

slides.title: What the checklist really does
slides.body:
It moves every decision *out of the window*.
The window is for execution.

slides.title: Plan at 2pm. Execute at 2am. Never think at 2am.
slides.body:
